# Sample places

*Generated by `cargo run --release --bin lang -- places` from the `samples` in `assets/lang/places.ron`.*

The game shows the English name. The founders' form (in bold) is the place's own name; the other three are what the other peoples call it. A town is one English word; a piece of the land is two.
